snippet.title: Talaka – #PlayAcclaim | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3815370/Talaka

Welcome to Talaka! A fast-paced, combat-driven roguelite that brings Afro-Brazilian mythology to life in a vivid, hand-painted world.

You play as a young warrior fighting to restore balance as ancient Orisha legends unravel into chaos. Journey through dreamlike landscapes, face divine trials, and uncover why the myths have gone rogue. With the gods at your side, every battle becomes a living canvas.

What to Expect:

• Battle Brazilian Demi-Gods – Clash with Orishas and twisted legends in cosmic boss fights that demand skill, timing, and mastery of mythic patterns.
• A Living Canvas of Culture – Explore watercolor-painted biomes inspired by Afro-Brazilian heritage, Candomblé rituals, and jungle folklore.
• Dynamic Roguelite Combat – Fast, fluid, reactive battles with panic-rolls, parries, god-blessed weapons, and ever-changing relics.
• Choose Your Path – Branching narratives, divine blessings, and moral choices that shape the fate of the myths themselves.
• A Soundtrack Rooted in Spirit – Drums, chants, and melodies composed with Afro-Brazilian musicians to evoke the rhythm of rebirth.

Talaka is a myth-soaked roguelite where every run reshapes the story. Will you rewrite the legend—or let it fade into oblivion?
